description:
`<tp-animation>` applique une animation à une cible du DOM léger.

Le composant utilise animate.css pour les noms d'animation
et WAAPI pour le contrôle de lecture.

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Wait before each animation, with an explicit time unit such as 200ms or 0.5s.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Duration of one animation cycle, with an explicit time unit such as 500ms or 2s.

attributes.name: easing
attributes.description: CSS timing function controlling the animation pace, for example linear, ease-in-out or cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Styles retained outside playback: none, forwards (after), backwards (during the delay), or both.

attributes.name: in
attributes.description: Animate.css entrance animation name, such as fadeIn; empty means no entrance animation.

attributes.name: iterations
attributes.description: Positive number of playback cycles, or infinite for continuous repetition. Invalid values use one cycle.

attributes.name: once
attributes.description: Limits automatic click, hover/focus and intersection triggers to their first playback.

attributes.name: out
attributes.description: Animate.css exit animation name used by playOut(), such as fadeOut; empty means no exit animation.

attributes.name: paused
attributes.description: Pauses playback when present; removing it allows the animation to resume.

attributes.name: root-margin
attributes.description: Viewport margin for the intersection trigger, using CSS margin syntax such as 100px or 0px 0px -20% 0px.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: CSS selector of a descendant to animate. When absent, the first child element is used.

attributes.name: threshold
attributes.description: Visibility thresholds for the intersection trigger: one number from 0 to 1, or a comma-separated list. Invalid entries are ignored; the fallback is 0.1.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Playback trigger: load, click, hover (also keyboard focus), intersection (entering the viewport), or manual (playIn()/playOut()).

methods.name: cancel(): void
methods.description: Cancels the current animation, clears its playback reference and emits tp-animation-cancel when an animation existed.

methods.name: pause(): void
methods.description: Pauses the current animation at its current time; does nothing when no animation exists.

methods.name: play(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Starts the entrance animation from the beginning, like playIn(); resolves when playback finishes or is cancelled.

methods.name: playIn(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Cancels the current animation and plays the configured in animation. Resolves on completion or cancellation; does nothing if the target or animation name is missing.

methods.name: playOut(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Cancels the current animation and plays the configured out animation. Resolves on completion or cancellation; does nothing if the target or animation name is missing.

methods.name: restart(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Starts the configured entrance animation again from the beginning; returns the same completion promise as playIn().

events.name: tp-animation-cancel
events.description: Emitted when cancel() cancels an existing animation, including cancellation before starting another phase. The detail contains the configured entrance and exit animation names.

events.name: tp-animation-finish
events.description: Emitted after an entrance or exit animation finishes normally; cancellation does not emit finish. The detail identifies the configured animation names and the phase.

events.name: tp-animation-start
events.description: Emitted when an entrance or exit animation starts, including when immediately paused. The detail identifies the configured animation names and the phase.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-animation>` element implements the <tp-icon name="animation" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Animation functionality: `<tp-animation>` applique une animation à une cible du DOM léger. Le composant utilise animate.css pour les noms d'animation et WAAPI pour le contrôle de lecture.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Content may animate when it appears, when you click it or when you move the pointer over it, depending on the page. |
| Using the component | There is no separate animation toolbar. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Starts a click-triggered animation when its target is not a native control. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |

keyboard.description: Starts a click-triggered animation when its target is not a native control.
